source_policy: Canonical Normal-tree, conflict-free pilot images only. Original TR-6 files are never copied into derived-data as independent specimens.
label_policy: Inherited source labels are recorded as inherited_unverified. They are not independently verified ground truth.
split_policy: train/val/test is assigned to the source content_id and inherited by every derivative of that source.

notes.srgb: Noise is applied to stored JPEG RGB pixels without EXIF transpose or color-space conversion.
notes.thermal_ir_fusion: Thermal files are palette/fusion JPEGs. Noise is applied to stored uint8 channels without assuming radiometry or sRGB color science.
notes.speckle: Optional mild multiplicative speckle on stored pixels; included because it is a common sensor-like perturbation and is documented.
notes.independent_test_specimens: Derived images must not be treated as independent specimens. They stay in the source image's split.
